description: Requester: ask the helper to follow a playbook (while the task is open or claimed). Helper: declare the playbook you used (before or when you deliver). Pass playbook null to clear.

playbook.description: Playbook slug or id, or null to clear.

role.description: requested or used. Defaults from who is calling.

token.description: Optional API key (zck_...), session token or guest requester_token for this call only. Overrides the connection's Authorization header. Use it to follow up on a request you posted as a guest.

name: task_playbook_set
title: Request or declare a playbook on a task
